sql: WITH lp AS (SELECT DISTINCT pe.ZnodeProductId AS productId, pe.Name AS name, pe.SKU AS sku, p.PortalId AS portalId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity c INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity v ON v.VersionId = c.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = c.ZnodeCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal p ON p.PortalId = pc.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h ON h.PimCategoryHierarchyId = c.ZnodeCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryProduct cp ON cp.PimCategoryId = h.PimCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe ON pe.ZnodeProductId = cp.PimProductId AND pe.VersionId = c.VersionId WHERE v.RevisionType = @revisionType AND v.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND v.LocaleId = @localeId AND c.IsActive = @isActive AND p.StoreCode = @store AND c.ZnodeCategoryId = @categoryId AND cp.Status = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, c.ZnodeCategoryId, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, pe.ZnodeCategoryIds, @comma)) > @zero), src AS (SELECT lp.productId AS productId, lp.productId AS sourceId FROM lp UNION SELECT lp.productId, ta.PimProductId FROM lp INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation ta ON ta.PimParentProductId = lp.productId), pv AS (SELECT s.productId AS productId, a.AttributeCode AS attributeCode, pdv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId AS valueId FROM src s INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av ON av.PimProductId = s.sourceId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute a ON a.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimFrontendProperties fp ON fp.PimAttributeId = a.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeDefaultValue pdv ON pdv.PimAttributeValueId = av.PimAttributeValueId WHERE fp.IsFacets = @isActive AND pdv.LocaleId = @localeId AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, a.AttributeCode, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, @attributeCodes, @comma)) > @zero), fv AS (SELECT pv.attributeCode AS attributeCode, MIN(CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, pv.attributeCode, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, @attributeCodes, @comma))) AS listPosition, MAX(al.AttributeName) AS attributeLabel, pv.valueId AS valueId, MAX(dv.AttributeDefaultValueCode) AS valueCode, MAX(dvl.AttributeDefaultValue) AS valueLabel, MAX(dv.DisplayOrder) AS valueOrder, COUNT(DISTINCT pv.productId) AS productCount FROM pv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValue dv ON dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = pv.valueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValueLocale dvl ON dvl.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeLocale al ON al.PimAttributeId = dv.PimAttributeId WHERE dvl.LocaleId = @localeId AND al.LocaleId = @localeId GROUP BY pv.attributeCode, pv.valueId), q AS (SELECT fv.attributeCode AS ac, fv.attributeLabel AS al, fv.valueId AS vi, fv.valueCode AS vc, fv.valueLabel AS vl, fv.productCount AS pc, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fv.listPosition) AS ar, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fv.attributeCode ORDER BY fv.productCount DESC, fv.valueOrder, fv.valueId) AS vr, COUNT(fv.valueId) OVER (PARTITION BY fv.attributeCode) AS va FROM fv), r AS (SELECT q.ac, q.al, q.vi, q.vc, q.vl, q.pc, q.ar, q.va, CONCAT(q.ar, q.vr) AS sl FROM q), fr AS (SELECT lp.productId AS productId, lp.name AS name, lp.sku AS sku, gp.RetailPrice AS retailPrice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lp.productId) AS position FROM lp INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT pv.productId AS productId FROM pv INNER JOIN r ON r.ac = pv.attributeCode AND r.vi = pv.valueId WHERE r.sl = @s11) fp1 ON fp1.productId = lp.productId OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pz.RetailPrice FROM dbo.ZnodePrice pz INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList pl ON pl.PriceListId = pz.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plo ON plo.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId WHERE pz.SKU = lp.sku AND plo.PortalId = lp.portalId AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pz.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pz.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pz.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pz.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY plo.Precedence, pl.PriceListId, pz.PriceId) gp) SELECT TOP 1 MAX(CASE WHEN r.ar = @pos1 THEN r.ac END) AS facet1Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.ar = @pos1 THEN r.al END) AS facet1Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s11 THEN r.vc END) AS facet1Value1Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s11 THEN r.vl END) AS facet1Value1Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s11 THEN r.pc END) AS facet1Value1Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s12 THEN r.vc END) AS facet1Value2Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s12 THEN r.vl END) AS facet1Value2Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s12 THEN r.pc END) AS facet1Value2Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s13 THEN r.vc END) AS facet1Value3Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s13 THEN r.vl END) AS facet1Value3Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s13 THEN r.pc END) AS facet1Value3Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.ar = @pos2 THEN r.ac END) AS facet2Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.ar = @pos2 THEN r.al END) AS facet2Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s21 THEN r.vc END) AS facet2Value1Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s21 THEN r.vl END) AS facet2Value1Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s21 THEN r.pc END) AS facet2Value1Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s22 THEN r.vc END) AS facet2Value2Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s22 THEN r.vl END) AS facet2Value2Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s22 THEN r.pc END) AS facet2Value2Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s23 THEN r.vc END) AS facet2Value3Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s23 THEN r.vl END) AS facet2Value3Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s23 THEN r.pc END) AS facet2Value3Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.ar = @pos3 THEN r.ac END) AS facet3Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.ar = @pos3 THEN r.al END) AS facet3Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s31 THEN r.vc END) AS facet3Value1Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s31 THEN r.vl END) AS facet3Value1Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s31 THEN r.pc END) AS facet3Value1Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s32 THEN r.vc END) AS facet3Value2Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s32 THEN r.vl END) AS facet3Value2Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s32 THEN r.pc END) AS facet3Value2Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s33 THEN r.vc END) AS facet3Value3Code, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s33 THEN r.vl END) AS facet3Value3Label, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s33 THEN r.pc END) AS facet3Value3Count, MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s11 THEN r.pc END) AS filteredCount, MAX(f.fp1Name) AS filteredProduct1Name, MAX(f.fp1Sku) AS filteredProduct1Sku, MAX(f.fp1ProductId) AS filteredProduct1ProductId, MAX(f.fp1RetailPrice) AS filteredProduct1RetailPrice, MAX(f.fp2Name) AS filteredProduct2Name, MAX(f.fp2Sku) AS filteredProduct2Sku, MAX(f.fp2ProductId) AS filteredProduct2ProductId, MAX(f.fp2RetailPrice) AS filteredProduct2RetailPrice, MAX(f.fp3Name) AS filteredProduct3Name, MAX(f.fp3Sku) AS filteredProduct3Sku, MAX(f.fp3ProductId) AS filteredProduct3ProductId, MAX(f.fp3RetailPrice) AS filteredProduct3RetailPrice FROM r CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN fr.position = @pos1 THEN fr.name END) AS fp1Name, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.position = @pos1 THEN fr.sku END) AS fp1Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.position = @pos1 THEN fr.productId END) AS fp1ProductId, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.position = @pos1 THEN fr.retailPrice END) AS fp1RetailPrice, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.position = @pos2 THEN fr.name END) AS fp2Name, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.position = @pos2 THEN fr.sku END) AS fp2Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.position = @pos2 THEN fr.productId END) AS fp2ProductId, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.position = @pos2 THEN fr.retailPrice END) AS fp2RetailPrice, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.position = @pos3 THEN fr.name END) AS fp3Name, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.position = @pos3 THEN fr.sku END) AS fp3Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.position = @pos3 THEN fr.productId END) AS fp3ProductId, MAX(CASE WHEN fr.position = @pos3 THEN fr.retailPrice END) AS fp3RetailPrice FROM fr) f HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.ac) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.PimAttributeId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttribute x WHERE CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, x.AttributeCode, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, @attributeCodes, @comma)) > @zero) AND MIN(r.va) >= @minValuesPerAttribute AND MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s11 THEN r.pc END) >= @minProductsForValue AND MAX(CASE WHEN r.sl = @s11 THEN r.pc END) <= @maxProductsForValue ORDER BY facet1Code
